description: This file defines Swagger API documentation classes for the Accounts API in a Fineract-based microfinance system. It includes various response and request data transfer object (DTO) classes annotated with Swagger Schema annotations, representing different API payloads related to account and product information.

classes.name: AccountsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested static classes representing Swagger-annotated DTOs for various account API responses and requests.
